Use case: stylized-concept. NEW KFB historical military ink-monster family. Exactly SIX complete unique cartoon-claymation ink blob monsters in a LANDSCAPE 1536x1024 transparent PNG,3 columns x2rows. Reference1 STYLE ONLY for rounded continuous footless ink body and soft plasticine material; reference2 STYLE ONLY for rich sculpted accessory craft. NOT source identities or repeated grins or red eyeballs. Continuous charcoal-black goo body, subtle deep violet sheen, thick soft rounded asymmetrical splat lobes and a few rounded ink droplets. Huge expressive face directly in blob, short goo hands, upright camera-facing. No human torso, legs, feet, bust crops or humanoid action figures. Fine clay fingerprints and thick handmade fabric, leather, metal. Not generic glossy Pixar people; weird, offbeat and tragically relatable military-bureaucracy satire. WHITE/IVORY sclera, RED iris, BLACK pupil, purple eyelids fully filled. Eyes never hidden by hats or goggles. Exactly two female-read through subtle lids/lashes, no human anatomy. Teeth only INSIDE mouth descending from upper gum, never on outer lower lip; closed mouths toothless. Each1–2dominant accessory anchors, body remains visible. Historical visual inspiration, not exact reenactment. No text/lettering/numbers, flags, political emblems, extremist insignia, eagle badges, skull badges, slogans, propaganda or heroic leader portraits. Plain fictional uniforms. No blood/battle scene. Weapons are simple inert period props held safely beside figure; not firing/aiming toward camera.
Family: Deutscher Trupp. Palette and costume: German interwar/WWII-inspired field-grey and leather, plain Stahlhelm silhouette; army archetypes without political or extremist symbols.
TOP LEFT — Feldwebel Vorschriftsmäßig; maennlich-read; broad square rounded splat, plain field-grey steel helmet, whistle and little blank inspection card; eyes narrowed to unequal heights, enormous disgruntled toothless lower-lip pout. Personality: Can detect a regulation breach before a regulation exists.
TOP MIDDLE — Funker Empfangsbereit; weiblich-read; tall thin crooked ink blob with plain field-grey sidecap, headset high on cap, handset on short coiled cord; lashes and wildly divergent gaze, tiny confused toothless mouth. Personality: Receives certainty in bursts and doubt continuously.
TOP RIGHT — Gefreiter Gleichda; maennlich-read; low wide splat with plain steel helmet slightly askew, small rolled blanket at flank and wood-stock rifle safely upright; fierce broad open mouth with two upper teeth, brows not symmetrical. Personality: Attempts to look ready while wondering what ready is for.
BOTTOM LEFT — Werkmeister Klemmtnoch; maennlich-read; pear-shaped lopsided blob, dark padded work cap with goggles above eyes, one hefty spanner and oil can; one big weary eye, other half shut, sideways toothless sneer. Personality: Distrusts perfect machines and the people who promise them.
BOTTOM MIDDLE — Sanitäterin Haltstill; weiblich-read; round asymmetrical splat, simple grey cloth cap and small ivory apron patch below face, compact medical bag marked ivory plus, rolled bandage; lashes, stern concerned open smile with one upper tooth. Personality: Issues kindness in a tone that sounds like an instruction.
BOTTOM RIGHT — Küchenwart Nachschlag; maennlich-read; tall drooping blob, field cap tucked under small folded cook cloth, metal ladle and lidded mess tin; high worried eyebrows, tiny open triangular toothless mouth. Personality: Must feed a queue that grows whenever he counts it.
COMPOSITION: Three columns,two rows. Equal substantial body scale, complete uncropped silhouettes and props each within about460x440px cell. Uniform visible heights across rows.32px clear transparent row/column gutters and generous outer margin. Do not overlap characters. All six self-contained,no floor,ground disc,backdrop,scenery,text,labels,border or gridlines. True transparent alpha.
